text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oooh, Opera O-san!
Today is the sh-sh... show!!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
O-O-Opera O-san,
are we h-h-having a match todaaaay?

And—the paddock on the day
of the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: O-O-Opera O-san!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: What is it, Doto?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Today is... today is... Todaayyy!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Let's do thiiiiiiis!!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...!!

All that practice paid off,
and Meisho Doto successfully
declared her rivalry.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Gah!!
Doto... you did what!?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ohh...! To think my most beloved vassal
would betray me!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hyauu... She's mad...
Opera O-san really is mad at me, nooo.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I will never forgive this rage!
Thiiisss indignaaation—!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Head exploding, burn, burn, burn!!
Then, let's haaaave a showdown♪ (A showdown!♪)

A bizarre musical broke out. As expected,
they weren't the sort of person to be fazed by something like this.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Doto! Are you saying that in this 'Japan Cup,'
you intend to stand before me not as a comrade,
but as a sworn enemy!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yeees... I wanna beat
Opera O-san, absolutely!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahaha! Then come at me! I shall cut you down with my Conqueror Spurt!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I-I won't let you!
I'll zoom right past youuu!!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Ooooh...!!

Amidst the playful banter, an undeniable passion erupted.
The audience, too, seemed to sense the shift between the two.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Doto. Very well, then.
Come at me with everything you've got. However—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
I utterly despise half-hearted acting. Having raised my expectations,
if you disappoint me, I won't forgive you, understood?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes—!!
